title: Shift covariance of the pinned single-complex base-change composite
statement: For schemes with chosen derived categories [def-pc-derived-category] and additive tensor pullbacks [def-pc-module-pullback], any commutative square [def-pc-fibre-product], integer n, and functor H from the lower-right derived category to a category with integer shifts, with H commuting with shifts, the source and target of the single-complex base-change composite [def-pc-derived-base-change-map] in degree n have natural isomorphisms to their degree-zero counterparts shifted by -n. Under these isomorphisms the pinned tensor-counit composite [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition] is H of its degree-zero counterpart shifted by -n.

source.place: Remark 20.28.3, canonical derived base-change mate; Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Shift/SingleFunctors.lean and Mathlib/Algebra/Homology/DerivedCategory/Basic.lean, integer single-functor shifts.

proof.text: Choose compatible shifts for the selected pullback counits. Obtain the base-change mate as a shift-compatible natural transformation and the final tensor counit as a SingleFunctors morphism. Postcompose the mate with the derived single family, compose the family associator and direct image of the tensor morphism, then postcompose with H.

The resulting family morphism has exactly the components H of singleDegreeBaseChangeComposite, by the two component identities and the identity associator component. Take the inverse shiftIso(-n,n,0) on its source and target. Evaluate Hom.comm at G and cancel the source shift isomorphism and the target inverse comparison to obtain the required equation.

proof_origin.place: N1: explicit composition of shift-compatible SingleFunctors morphisms, followed by cancellation of their degree-n shift comparisons.

theorem pinned_single_base_change_shift
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ {Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (k : Y ⟶ Z), (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback k).Additive]
    {X S X' S' : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (g : S' ⟶ S)
    (g' : X' ⟶ X) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (h : g' ≫ f = f' ≫ g)
    {D : Type*} [Category D] [HasShift D ℤ]
    (H : schemeDerivedCategory.{u, w} S' ⥤ D) [H.CommShift ℤ] (n : ℤ) :
    ∃ a : singleDegreeBaseChangeSource.{u, w} f g n ⋙ H ≅
        (singleDegreeBaseChangeSource.{u, w} f g 0 ⋙ H) ⋙ shiftFunctor D (-n),
    ∃ b : singleDegreeBaseChangeTarget.{u, w} g' f' n ⋙ H ≅
        (singleDegreeBaseChangeTarget.{u, w} g' f' 0 ⋙ H) ⋙ shiftFunctor D (-n),
    ∀ G : X.Modules,
      H.map (singleDegreeBaseChangeComposite.{u, w} f g g' f' h n G) ≫ b.hom.app G =
        a.hom.app G ≫ (shiftFunctor D (-n)).map
          (H.map (singleDegreeBaseChangeComposite.{u, w} f g g' f' h 0 G))
